To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the supply chain performance of the firm can be improved by the implementation of supply chain strategies; (2) the performance of the firm in the supply chain can be improved by a better understanding and implementation of the key drivers of the supply chain; (3) the performance of firms in the supply chain is positively correlated with the performance of the individual firms; and (4) the supply chain strategy of the firm has a significant impact on its supply chain performance.
